items.claim: Uros Medic has a 100 percent finish rate across all of his wins and losses.
items.quote: He has a 100% finish rate in his 13 wins and unfortunately his three losses as well.

items.claim: Uros Medic's takedown defense statistics are skewed by being taken down seven times in one fight.
items.quote: State down defense sits at a middle of the road 55%, but that is a bit skewed because he was taken down seven times by Motoback Orobay

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez is a very good, crisp boxer who picks his shots well.
items.quote: a very good boxer who picks his shots well. ... His boxing is crisp

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez has good takedown defense but offers little in the grappling department.
items.quote: He's got good takedown defense, but not much to offer in the grappling department.

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez can fade and become hesitant when worried about takedowns.
items.quote: When he is worried, he can fade, he can be a little hesitant, and doesn't get things going

items.claim: Daniel Rodriguez was imprisoned in Mexico for around eight months on a drug trafficking charge.
items.quote: they slapped a trafficking charge on him and they locked him up for around eight months.
